description: mnemosyne hooks — SessionStart injects recalled memories, SessionEnd/PreCompact enqueue the transcript for drain. Invokes the bundled, self-contained CLI at ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/.claude-plugin/dist/cli.bundle.mjs (no separate npm install required). NOTE (mnemosyne#29, out of scope for this plugin's #28 bundling work): if a user ALSO runs `mnemosyne install-hooks` for claude on top of installing this plugin, hooks will fire twice — that dedup gap is tracked separately, not fixed here.
